theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (A : Euclid d →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (v : Euclid d), IsOpen W → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → v ∈ V → HasFDerivAt ψ A v → Injective A → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ v' ∈ V, dist (ψ v') (ψ v) < δ → dist v' v < ε) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ N, dist y (ψ v) < δ → ∃ a : Euclid d, ‖y - ψ v - A a‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - ψ v‖
